rules: A step whose canonical function or screen does not exist on the tested build is 'blocked' with its reason — never 'pass'.
A scenario is 'pass' only when every one of its steps ran and passed; any failed step makes it 'fail'; otherwise any blocked step makes it 'blocked'.

The API runner (ops/staging/run_scenarios.py) runs the steps with an 'api_check'. Steps with 'ui' are the browser part for the Bot session; the API runner reports them as blocked UI_NOT_RUN_BY_API_RUNNER.
Navigation placeholders do not count as a working screen.
